# ankra_cluster_gateway_api (Resource)

Turns the Kubernetes Gateway API on for a cluster Ankra provisions (`ankra cluster gateway-api enable`). Ankra records the option, adds the Gateway API CRDs (or uses a bundle the cluster already carries) and, once they are established, writes the Gateway API keys into the Traefik and cert-manager values through the ordinary stack write. The cluster needs Ankra-managed networking. The platform can only turn the Gateway API on, so destroy leaves it on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_gateway_api" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_kind` (String) Kind of the cluster, resolved from the platform; it selects the API lane.
- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `phase` (String) Where the enable stands, such as `crds_pending`, `values_pending`, `applying` or `enabled`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_gateway_api.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
